item.name: Public API to import Clozd deal and participant data

request.name: Public API to import Clozd deal and participant data

description.content:
Public API to import 1 or many deals and 0 or many participants associated with the deal. Make sure the header is set with a key value pair being Key: x-api-token Value: (api token provided from the settings section within the Clozd application). The body of the post request will follow the schema below. If an attribute is required or a wrong value type is provided the POST request will be rolled back and rejected. 
 - Program id is required, you can get the program id from the settings page within the Clozd app. 
 - Custom fields are acceptable. The key name must match the name of the field name created in Clozd app exactly. 
 - Participants are included within the deal object 
 - Names of properties and display names are not always the same

variable.description: (Required) Clozd program ID (min:36 chars, max:36 chars)

response.name: Successful import operation
